newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian stocks calm, Lode, Strenci gain.
newsitem.headline: Latvian stocks calm, Lode, Strenci gain.

text.p: Latvian share volumes fell on Wednesday amid calm trade while Lode Brick and Strenci Forestry both gained ground on positive 1996 results, dealers said.
Total volume was 152,000 lats versus 210,000 lats, while Rietumu Bank's index added just 0.32 percent to 227.35 points.
Secondary list shares Lode Brick and Strenci Forestry both advanced almost 15 percent on good 1996 results.
Strenci added 19 santimes to 1.51 lats and traded 1,500 lats of shares and Lode jumped 37 santimes to 2.87 lats on volume of 8,800 lats.
Daugavpils Chain factory on the secondary list stayed put at 2.80 lats and registered the highest turnover of 37,000 lats.
Official list stock Unibanka remained stable at 4.70 lats on volume of 23,800 lats. Staburadze confectionery slipped by one santime to 2.78 and traded 19,000 lats.
Valmiera Glassfibre traded 15,700 lats of shares and fell five santimes to 2.12 lats.
Elsewhere on the official list, the Riga Transport Fleet advanced three closed three santimes up at 1.66 lats on volume of 6,000 lats.
Among fish canneries Kaija turned over 12,300 lats of shares and remained stable at 2.35 lats and Liepaja registered trade of 8,500 lats and did not move from 1.50 lats.

Metalserviss and Rigas Raugs yeast factory gained ground slightly. Metalserviss added five santimes to 65 santimes on trade of 400 lats and Raugs also gained five santimes to 4.05 lats on volume of 400 lats.
